_doc: Projects (plugins/projects). calendar_past_days / calendar_future_days: how far back and ahead the calendar is read. exclude_calendars: calendars to leave out, by id or name (holiday calendars are always left out). tasks_completed_days: completed tasks older than this are not read. repo_roots: folders whose sub-folders are git repositories to read commit activity from ([] = none). repo_days: how far back commits are read. wiki_recent_days: how many days of recently changed wiki pages the bundle lists. max_new_pages_per_run: the most project pages one night may create. tasks_list: the Google Tasks list the user's project tasks go on (@default = their main list). nudge_every_days: at most one follow-up per slipped task in this many days. deep_reviews_per_night: projects that get the deep 'how do we move this forward' pass each night (a rotation). work_weekly_share: the share of the weekly allowance Jori's own work on project tasks (project-work) may spend in 7 days; 0 turns the lane off. work_tasks_per_night: the most tasks it takes on a night. money_on_pages: amounts (costs, quotes, budgets, balances) may appear on project pages and task titles; account numbers and health details never do. schedules: this installation's own schedule time, if not the manifest's.
